query: select game, payload from ml_private.daily_catalogue where concat(payload->>'q',' ',payload->>'s',' ',payload->>'l',' ',payload->>'r') ~* '(binturong|okapi|fossa|wombat|banknot|geldschein|tower bridge|forth bridge|queensferry|iron bridge|kanaltunnel|channel tunnel|eurotunnel|ackerland|arable|wasseranteil|wasserfläche|breitengrad|census|urbaner|urbanisiert|65 jahre|65-jähr)'
limitations: Read-only subject/metric search on all rows; catalogue has three games, no Jeopardy. No write or publication.
